description: Senarai lengkap kod lokasi UN/LOCODE untuk Malaysia. All 348 UN/LOCODE entries for Malaysia from the UNECE United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations: LOCODE, place name (with and without diacritics), subdivision, function classifiers (sea port, rail, road, airport, postal, multimodal), approval status, IATA code and coordinates. Function legend embedded per record; status codes per UNECE status-indicators table.

meta.title: Kod lokasi UN/LOCODE — Malaysia (pelabuhan, lapangan terbang, terminal) - Muat turun percuma
meta.description: Senarai lengkap kod lokasi UN/LOCODE untuk Malaysia. All 348 UN/LOCODE entries for Malaysia from the UNECE United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations: LOCODE, place name (with and without diacritics), subdivision, function classifiers (sea port, rail, road, airport, postal, multimodal), approval status, IATA code and coordinates. Function legend embedded per record; status codes per UNECE status-indicators table. Mengandungi 348 rekod. Muat turun dalam format Excel, CSV, PDF.
